items.quote: 40:26 And he put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation before the vail:
items.claim: The golden altar was placed in the tent of the congregation, in front of the veil.
items.actor: he (Moses, inferred from the phrase 'as the LORD commanded Moses' in the next verse; not named in this verse)
items.place: tent of the congregation, before the vail
items.mechanism: physical placement of a cult furnishing

items.quote: 40:27 And he burnt sweet incense thereon; as the LORD commanded Moses.
items.claim: Sweet incense was burned on the golden altar, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
items.actor: he (Moses, inferred; not named as the subject)
items.object: sweet incense on the golden altar
items.mechanism: ritual act done because of a divine command ('as the LORD commanded Moses')
